rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a physical card, including a generic greeting card when the context makes the type clear.

example.english: I bought a card to send to you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 kaa1 pin2 gei3 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this specifically for a bank-issued card rather than a plain card or a business card.

example.english: The ATM swallowed my bank card.
example.traditional: 我張銀行卡畀提款機食咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 ngan4 hong4 kaat1 bei2 tai4 fun2 gei1 sik6 zo2

rows.note: Use this for an individual playing card or a pack of playing cards.

example.jyutping: ngo5 cau1 dou2 jat1 zoeng1 be1 paai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a business card exchanged for contact details.

example.english: They handed me a business card and told me to contact them if I needed anything.
example.traditional: 佢遞咗張名片畀我，叫我有事搵佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dai6 zo2 zoeng1 ming4 pin2 bei2 ngo5 giu3 ngo5 jau5 si6 wan2 keoi5
